Callout.Name: Livestock Theft
Callout.Message: Cattle reported taken from a field overnight.
Callout.Advisory: Trailer tracks at the gate, no suspects present.

Script.Line: The gate was cut and there are trailer tracks heading out.
Twenty head. That is a big trailer and two people.
They will have gone to the city with them. That is where they go.

Lines.Approach: The gate was cut and the tracks are fresh. Whoever did it is long gone.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
